matches.summary: Double Counter, a service that protects Discord servers from raids and alt accounts, has suffered a data breach that exposed about 1 million email addresses, as well as Discord IDs and IP addresses for millions more users.
matches.title: Discord protection bot Double Counter hit by breach exposing around 1 million email addresses
